# Islande 2027

This repository contains a static, offline-first PWA for an Iceland road trip. It is hosted on Netlify, uses inline HTML/CSS/JavaScript in the root `index.html`, and connects to an existing Supabase database. Never modify the existing Supabase database or schema, and do not add SQL.

The product has no accounts or login. It must remain usable offline, fast to operate one-handed, and dependable in urgent situations.

- Make targeted changes and work on one coherent batch at a time.
- Never commit directly to `main`.
- Do not add a dependency without a clear justification.
